item.title: Jeremiah Smith Named Big Ten Receiver of the Year, Julian Sayin Freshman of the Year, Indiana’s Fernando Mendoza Big Ten Offensive Player of the Year
item.description: The award tour continues for Ohio State on day two of Big Ten honors, though perhaps not all Buckeye fans felt they deserved. In one of the bigger no-brainers of the college football season, Jeremiah Smith is the Big Ten Receiver of the Year, winning that award for the second year in a row. item.title: Film Study: Winning Both Lines of Scrimmage Allowed Ohio State to Win 'The Game'
item.description: Ryan Day won it his way. And theirs. In a bit of irony that was surely sweet for Ohio State's head coach, the Buckeyes beat their archrival by being the more physical team along the line of scrimmage on both sides of the ball. But they were able to do so by presenting so many threats at the skill positions. Day broke a four-game losing streak in the rivalry, thanks more to talent and execution than to scheme. item.title: Ryan Day Radio Show: Ryan Day Calls Indiana “A Different Team” From Last Season With Upgrades Across the Board, Says Buckeyes “Have a Lot of Respect For This Opponent”

item.title: Ohio State Wide Receiver Commit Chris Henry Jr. Still Weighing Options on Signing Day: “I Just Want to Make the Right Decision For My Future”
item.description: Chris Henry Jr. committed to Ohio State in July 2023 and shut down his recruitment in April 2025. However, in the aftermath of Brian Hartline's decision to become USF's next head coach, Henry has not yet signed with the Buckeyes. Instead, the five-star receiver is still weighing his options, he said Wednesday on X. I have not signed yet. item.title: Julian Sayin Named Finalist for Walter Camp Player of the Year, Ryan Day Named Finalist for Walter Camp Coach of the Year
item.description: Few in college football can match the talent of Julian Sayin or the coaching prowess of Ryan Day. The Walter Camp Football Foundation named Sayin as a finalist for its Player of the Year award and Day as a finalist for its Coach of the Year award on Thursday. Sayin is one of five finalists for Player of the Year, along with Indiana quarterback Fernando Mendoza, Vanderbilt quarterback Diego Pavia, Notre Dame running back Jeremiyah Love and Texas Tech linebacker Jacob Rodriguez. item.title: Legend Bey Reportedly Coerced By Family Members to Flip from Ohio State to Tennessee, Could Seek Release from Signing with Volunteers
item.description: Legend Bey’s signing day flip from Ohio State to Tennessee appears not to have been his own choice. At his signing ceremony at North Forney (Texas) High School on Wednesday, the four-star running back/wide receiver sat at a table adorned with Ohio State gear and told Ishmael Johnson of the Dallas Morning News that he was signing with the Buckeyes despite offensive coordinator Brian Hartline’s departure for USF. item.title: Ohio State’s Win Over Michigan Drew 18.4 Million Viewers, the Most of Any College Football Game This Season
item.description: More people watched Ohio State beat Michigan than any other game during the 2025 college football regular season. 18.4 million viewers tuned in for the Buckeyes’ 27-9 win over the Wolverines, surpassing Ohio State’s season-opening win over Texas – which drew 16.6 million viewers – for the most-watched college football game this season.
